title: Certified Adaptive Quantum Dynamics from Projection Residuals
description: Reviewed research preprint with a classical conditional actual-defect observable bound, a domain-corrected product retraction differential, and a finite cluster-product numerical prototype. Initial mismatch and the premises for an edge decomposition are explicit. The Python solver samples ideal tangent residuals but does not certify numerical integration, quadrature, or requested tolerance; its status is HEURISTIC_UNCERTIFIED. Six reproducible TFIM/XXZ reference comparisons are provided. Lean sources establish conditional abstract Nat/Int finite-sum inequalities with supplied Holder, contractivity, and residual-domination hypotheses, not continuous-time density-matrix analysis. The stored axiom report is historical; a fresh pinned Lean 4.34.0 build and all 11 selected audit declarations passed on 2026-10-11, retaining that conditional scope. Sampled-bound utilities refuse nonfinite derived estimates; this adds no numerical-certification claim. Text and figures are CC-BY-4.0 (LICENSE); code, notebooks, tooling, and Lean sources are Apache-2.0 (LICENSE-CODE).
